blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 ISO 9001:2015 第五版相較 2008 版的核心變更，包括 Annex SL 架構與風險導向思維的引入
blocks.en: Understand the core changes in ISO 9001:2015 (fifth edition) compared with the 2008 version, including the Annex SL structure and the introduction of risk-based thinking

blocks.zh: 掌握 PDCA 循環在品質管理體系的整體運作邏輯，對應第 4–10 節架構
blocks.en: Grasp how the PDCA cycle drives the quality management system as a whole, mapped to the structure of Clauses 4-10

blocks.zh: 理解「組織背景」(Clause 4) 的 PESTLE 分析框架及利害關係人管理
blocks.en: Understand the PESTLE analysis framework and stakeholder management behind "context of the organization" (Clause 4)

blocks.zh: 說明最高管理者在 ISO 9001:2015 中的 10 項領導承諾要求
blocks.en: Explain the 10 leadership commitments required of top management in ISO 9001:2015

blocks.zh: 區分舊版「預防措施」與新版「風險導向思維」(6.1) 的概念差異
blocks.en: Distinguish the old "preventive action" from the new "risk-based thinking" (6.1)

blocks.zh: 解釋「組織知識」(7.1.6) 在製藥 CDMO 環境中的重要性與實施挑戰
blocks.en: Explain the importance of "organizational knowledge" (7.1.6) in a pharmaceutical CDMO and the challenges of implementing it

blocks.zh: 掌握「文件化資訊」取代「記錄/文件/程序」的統一概念 (7.5)
blocks.en: Grasp the unified concept of "documented information", which replaces "records/documents/procedures" (7.5)

blocks.zh: 前言 — 第五版歷史背景
blocks.en: Foreword: Background to the Fifth Edition

blocks.zh: 版本演進 & 生效背景
blocks.en: Version History & Context

blocks.zh: 2015 版核心三大變革
blocks.en: Three Core Changes in the 2015 Version

blocks.zh: Annex SL 通用架構：與 ISO 14001、45001 等共用高階結構，方便整合管理體系
blocks.en: Annex SL common structure: shares the high-level structure with ISO 14001, ISO 45001 and others, making it easier to integrate management systems

blocks.zh: 風險導向思維：從被動「預防措施」轉為主動識別並管理風險與機會
blocks.en: Risk-based thinking: moves from reactive "preventive action" to proactively identifying and managing risks and opportunities

blocks.zh: 組織背景：要求組織系統性理解內外部議題與利害關係人
blocks.en: Context of the organization: requires the organization to systematically understand internal and external issues and interested parties

blocks.zh: 比喻：從「消防演習」到「風險預測」
blocks.en: Analogy: From "Fire Drills" to "Risk Forecasting"

blocks.zh: 2008 版就像每次出事才訓練消防隊（預防措施）。2015 版要求組織像保險精算師一樣，事先繪製風險地圖、評估機率與影響，並針對高風險預先布置滅火系統。
blocks.en: The 2008 version was like training the fire brigade only after each fire (preventive action). The 2015 version expects an organization to act like an insurance actuary: map the risks in advance, assess likelihood and impact, and install fire suppression in advance where the risk is high.

blocks.zh: QMS 作為策略決策
blocks.en: The QMS as a Strategic Decision

blocks.zh: 重點解析
blocks.en: Key Points

blocks.zh: QMS = 策略工具，不是行政負擔
blocks.en: The QMS Is a Strategic Tool, Not an Administrative Burden

blocks.zh: 標準開宗明義：導入 QMS 是策略決策（strategic decision）。這意味著 QMS 不只是用來通過客戶審核的紙本作業，而是協助組織達成業務目標的管理架構。
blocks.en: The standard states up front that adopting a QMS is a strategic decision. This means the QMS is not just paperwork to pass a customer audit, but a management framework that helps the organization achieve its business objectives.

blocks.zh: 對製藥 CDMO 來說，這等同於說：ISO 9001 認證是你向潛在客戶展示「我們有能力持續穩定供貨」的市場信號。
blocks.en: For a pharmaceutical CDMO, this means ISO 9001 certification is a market signal to prospective clients that "we can supply consistently and reliably."

blocks.zh: 「shall」vs「should」— 查核重點
blocks.en: "shall" vs "should": Audit Focus

blocks.zh: 稽核時最重要的用字辨別：
blocks.en: The most important wording distinction in an audit:

blocks.zh: shall = 強制要求，審核員必查
blocks.en: shall = mandatory requirement; the auditor will always check it

blocks.zh: should = 建議，可選擇性實施
blocks.en: should = recommendation; implementation is optional

blocks.zh: 許多組織誤將 should 當 shall，或忽略 shall 的要求，都是不符合項的常見原因。
blocks.en: Treating a should as a shall, or overlooking a shall requirement, are common causes of nonconformities.

blocks.zh: 比喻：ISO 9001 在製藥業的定位
blocks.en: Analogy: Where ISO 9001 Sits in the Pharmaceutical Industry

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 是品質管理的「基礎建設」。ISO 13485（醫療器材）和 ISO 15378（藥品包材）都是在 9001 的地基上蓋起的專業建築。掌握 9001，等於掌握整個 ISO 品質家族的共同語言。
blocks.en: ISO 9001 is the "foundation" of quality management. ISO 13485 (medical devices) and ISO 15378 (primary packaging materials for medicinal products) are specialized buildings erected on the 9001 foundation. Mastering 9001 means mastering the common language of the whole ISO quality family.

blocks.zh: ISO 品質標準生態系
blocks.en: The ISO Quality Standards Ecosystem

blocks.zh: ISO 9000:2015 — 詞彙與基本原則
blocks.en: ISO 9000:2015 — Fundamentals and Vocabulary

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2015 — 要求（本文件）
blocks.en: ISO 9001:2015 — Requirements (this document)

blocks.zh: ↓ 延伸
blocks.en: ↓ Extends to

blocks.zh: 八大品質管理原則
blocks.en: The Quality Management Principles

blocks.zh: 八大原則在製藥 CDMO 的對應
blocks.en: How the Principles Map to a Pharmaceutical CDMO

blocks.zh: 比喻：原則是指南針，條款是地圖
blocks.en: Analogy: Principles Are the Compass, Clauses Are the Map

blocks.zh: 七大原則是 ISO 9001 的「哲學基礎」，而標準的具體條款（Clauses 4–10）是落地的地圖。理解原則，才能在無明確規定的情況下做出符合精神的判斷。
blocks.en: The seven principles are the "philosophical foundation" of ISO 9001, while the specific clauses (Clauses 4-10) are the map that puts them into practice. Understanding the principles lets you make judgments consistent with the intent of the standard when there is no explicit rule.

blocks.zh: 流程方法與 PDCA 循環 — 風險導向思維
blocks.en: Process Approach and the PDCA Cycle: Risk-Based Thinking

blocks.zh: PDCA 在製藥的實踐對應
blocks.en: PDCA Applied in Pharmaceuticals

blocks.zh:
P — Plan 策劃 (Cl. 4-7)
ICH Q8 設計空間、製程開發、品質目標設定、SOP 建立、資源規劃
blocks.en:
P — Plan (Cl. 4-7)
ICH Q8 design space, process development, quality objective setting, SOP creation, resource planning

blocks.zh:
D — Do 執行 (Cl. 8)
商業製造批次、無菌灌裝作業、供應商管理、客戶需求確認
blocks.en:
D — Do (Cl. 8)
Commercial manufacturing batches, aseptic filling operations, supplier management, confirmation of customer requirements

blocks.zh:
C — Check 查核 (Cl. 9)
QC 放行測試、OOS/OOT 調查、環境監測、內部稽核
blocks.en:
C — Check (Cl. 9)
QC release testing, OOS/OOT investigations, environmental monitoring, internal audits

blocks.zh:
A — Act 行動 (Cl. 10)
CAPA 執行、管理審查決議、製程改善、偏差根因消除
blocks.en:
A — Act (Cl. 10)
CAPA implementation, management review decisions, process improvement, elimination of root causes of deviations

blocks.zh: 流程單元（Turtle Diagram）概念
blocks.en: The Process Unit (Turtle Diagram) Concept

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 的流程方法要求每個核心流程都能回答：
blocks.en: The ISO 9001 process approach expects every core process to answer the following:

blocks.zh: 輸入 (Inputs)：這個流程需要什麼？
blocks.en: Inputs: What does this process need?

blocks.zh: 輸出 (Outputs)：這個流程產出什麼？
blocks.en: Outputs: What does this process produce?

blocks.zh: 資源 (Resources)：人員、設備、環境
blocks.en: Resources: People, equipment, environment

blocks.zh: 方法 (Methods)：SOP、指引、技術
blocks.en: Methods: SOPs, guidelines, techniques

blocks.zh: KPI：如何衡量這個流程是否有效？
blocks.en: KPIs: How do we measure whether this process is effective?

blocks.zh: 這正是「海龜圖（Turtle Diagram）」的框架，常用於製藥 QMS 流程描述。
blocks.en: This is exactly the framework of the "Turtle Diagram", which is commonly used to describe processes in a pharmaceutical QMS.

blocks.zh: 風險導向思維 vs 舊版預防措施
blocks.en: Risk-Based Thinking vs the Old Preventive Action

blocks.zh: 2008 版：8.5.3 要求組織訂定「預防措施」程序，通常淪為形式。
blocks.en: 2008 version: 8.5.3 required the organization to establish a documented "preventive action" procedure, which often became a formality.

blocks.zh: 2015 版：廢除了獨立的「預防措施」條款，改為將風險思維貫穿整個標準。組織必須在規劃階段（6.1）就識別風險並決定如何應對。
blocks.en: 2015 version: the standalone "preventive action" clause was removed, and risk-based thinking now runs throughout the entire standard. The organization must identify risks and decide how to address them already at the planning stage (6.1).

blocks.zh: 製藥應用：這與 ICH Q9 品質風險管理（FMEA、HACCP 等工具）的理念完全一致。
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical application: this is entirely consistent with the philosophy of ICH Q9 quality risk management (tools such as FMEA and HACCP).

blocks.zh: 比喻：從「出事再補救」到「先行設防」
blocks.en: Analogy: From "Fix It After the Accident" to "Build Safeguards First"

blocks.zh: 2008 版預防措施像是在十字路口撞車後才裝護欄。2015 版風險思維像是在設計道路時就做風險評估——哪些路口容易出事？應裝號誌還是圓環？先設計好，再開放通行。
blocks.en: The 2008 preventive action was like installing guardrails only after a crash at an intersection. The 2015 risk-based thinking is like carrying out a risk assessment while designing the road: which intersections are accident-prone, and should they get traffic lights or a roundabout? Design first, then open to traffic.

blocks.zh: 與其他標準的關係 — Annex SL
blocks.en: Relationship with Other Standards: Annex SL

blocks.zh: Annex SL 的意義與標準整合
blocks.en: The Meaning of Annex SL and Standards Integration

blocks.zh: Annex SL（高階結構）是什麼？
blocks.en: What Is Annex SL (the High-Level Structure)?

blocks.zh: ISO 為避免不同管理體系標準「各說各話」，設計了 Annex SL 通用框架：10 個相同的高階條款編號，讓各標準共享：
blocks.en: To keep different management system standards from "speaking different languages", ISO designed the Annex SL common framework: 10 identical high-level clause numbers that the standards share:

blocks.zh: 第 4 節：組織背景
blocks.en: Clause 4: Context of the organization

blocks.zh: 第 5 節：領導力
blocks.en: Clause 5: Leadership

blocks.zh: 第 6 節：策劃
blocks.en: Clause 6: Planning

blocks.zh: 第 7 節：支援
blocks.en: Clause 7: Support

blocks.zh: 第 8 節：運作
blocks.en: Clause 8: Operation

blocks.zh: 第 9 節：績效評估
blocks.en: Clause 9: Performance evaluation

blocks.zh: 第 10 節：改善
blocks.en: Clause 10: Improvement

blocks.zh: 採用 Annex SL 的標準包括：ISO 9001、ISO 14001（環境）、ISO 45001（職安衛）、ISO 27001（資安）等。
blocks.en: Standards that adopt Annex SL include ISO 9001, ISO 14001 (environment), ISO 45001 (occupational health and safety), ISO 27001 (information security) and others.

blocks.zh: 製藥業整合 QMS 的機會
blocks.en: Opportunities for an Integrated QMS in Pharmaceuticals

blocks.zh: 因為 Annex SL 共同架構，若工廠同時持有 ISO 9001 + ISO 14001 + ISO 45001，可整合為統一管理體系（IMS），降低文件重複與稽核負擔。
blocks.en: Because of the common Annex SL structure, a site that holds ISO 9001 + ISO 14001 + ISO 45001 can merge them into an integrated management system (IMS), reducing duplicated documents and audit burden.

blocks.zh: CDMO 場景：客戶審核 + ISO 9001 + cGMP 可在相似的文件框架下協同管理，節省維護成本。
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: customer audits, ISO 9001 and cGMP can be managed together under a similar documentation framework, saving maintenance cost.

blocks.zh: 比喻：Annex SL = USB-C 接口標準
blocks.en: Analogy: Annex SL = the USB-C Connector Standard

blocks.zh: 過去各管理標準像各廠商的充電接口——形狀不同、無法共用。Annex SL 就是 ISO 推出的「USB-C 標準」，讓所有管理體系標準用同一個架構插孔，整合更容易。
blocks.en: In the past, each management standard was like a different manufacturer's charging connector: different shapes, not interchangeable. Annex SL is ISO's "USB-C standard": all management system standards plug into the same structural socket, which makes integration much easier.

blocks.zh: 範圍、參考文件、術語定義
blocks.en: Scope, Normative References, Terms and Definitions

blocks.zh: 範圍與適用性解析
blocks.en: Scope and Applicability Explained

blocks.zh: 「All requirements applicable」— 適用性原則
blocks.en: "All requirements applicable": the Applicability Principle

blocks.zh: ISO 9001 要求組織適用所有條款，但允許在 Clause 4.3（QMS 範圍）中記錄哪些條款不適用及理由。
blocks.en: ISO 9001 requires the organization to apply all clauses, but allows it to record in Clause 4.3 (QMS scope) which clauses are not applicable, with justification.

blocks.zh: 常見不適用場景：
blocks.en: Common scenarios where a clause is not applicable:

blocks.zh: 純粹服務型組織 → 8.3 設計開發可能不適用
blocks.en: Pure service organization → 8.3 Design and development may not apply

blocks.zh: 不從事設計的製造廠 → 8.3 不適用，但必須記錄理由
blocks.en: Manufacturer that does no design → 8.3 does not apply, but the justification must be recorded

blocks.zh: 重要：不適用必須不影響組織「確保產品符合性和客戶滿意度」的能力。
blocks.en: Important: non-applicability must not affect the organization's ability to "ensure conformity of products and customer satisfaction."

blocks.zh: 製藥 CDMO 的適用範圍思考
blocks.en: Scope Considerations for a Pharmaceutical CDMO

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，通常所有條款都適用，因為：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, all clauses usually apply, because:

blocks.zh: 有設計開發（客製化製程 / 方法開發）→ 8.3 適用
blocks.en: It does design and development (customized process / method development) → 8.3 applies

blocks.zh: 有外包供應商（原料 / 分析服務）→ 8.4 適用
blocks.en: It uses external providers (raw materials / analytical services) → 8.4 applies

blocks.zh: 直接面對品牌藥廠客戶 → 顧客滿意度條款全部適用
blocks.en: It deals directly with brand-name pharmaceutical customers → all customer satisfaction clauses apply

blocks.zh: 比喻：9000 是字典，9001 是法規
blocks.en: Analogy: 9000 Is the Dictionary, 9001 Is the Regulation

blocks.zh: ISO 9000 像是醫學字典（告訴你每個詞的定義）。ISO 9001 像是《藥事法》（告訴你必須做什麼）。兩者必須配合使用，但只有 9001 能用於認證。
blocks.en: ISO 9000 is like a medical dictionary (it tells you what each term means). ISO 9001 is like the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act (it tells you what you must do). The two must be used together, but only 9001 can be used for certification.

blocks.zh: 組織背景 — 內外部議題、利害關係人、QMS 範圍與流程
blocks.en: Context of the Organization: Internal and External Issues, Interested Parties, QMS Scope and Processes

blocks.zh: 組織背景分析工具
blocks.en: Tools for Analyzing Organizational Context

blocks.zh: 4.2 — 利害關係人識別
blocks.en: 4.2: Identifying Interested Parties

blocks.zh: 製藥 CDMO 的主要利害關係人：
blocks.en: Main interested parties of a pharmaceutical CDMO:

blocks.zh: 客戶（品牌藥廠）：產品規格、技術轉移要求、稽核期望
blocks.en: Customers (brand-name pharmaceutical companies): product specifications, technology transfer requirements, audit expectations

blocks.zh: 主管機關（FDA / EMA / TFDA）：GMP 合規要求
blocks.en: Regulatory authorities (FDA / EMA / TFDA): GMP compliance requirements

blocks.zh: 員工：安全環境、公平待遇、職涯發展
blocks.en: Employees: safe environment, fair treatment, career development

blocks.zh: 供應商：長期合作條件、品質協議
blocks.en: Suppliers: long-term cooperation terms, quality agreements

blocks.zh: 投資者 / 股東：財務績效、法規風險管理
blocks.en: Investors / shareholders: financial performance, regulatory risk management

blocks.zh: 患者（最終使用者）：產品安全性、有效性
blocks.en: Patients (end users): product safety and efficacy

blocks.zh: 4.4 — 流程清單 (Process Inventory) 的重要性
blocks.en: 4.4: The Importance of a Process Inventory

blocks.zh: 4.4.1 要求組織確定所有 QMS 需要的流程。實務建議：
blocks.en: 4.4.1 requires the organization to determine all the processes needed for the QMS. Practical suggestions:

blocks.zh: 列出核心業務流程（如：接單 → 技術審查 → 製造 → QC → 放行 → 出貨）
blocks.en: List the core business processes (e.g., order intake → technical review → manufacturing → QC → release → shipment)

blocks.zh: 加入支援流程（HR、採購、設備維護、文件管理）
blocks.en: Add support processes (HR, purchasing, equipment maintenance, document management)

blocks.zh: 加入管理流程（策略規劃、管理審查、內部稽核）
blocks.en: Add management processes (strategic planning, management review, internal audit)

blocks.zh: 為每個流程指定流程擁有者（Process Owner）
blocks.en: Assign a process owner to each process

blocks.zh: 這份流程清單是 QMS 架構的骨幹，也是稽核員必查的文件化資訊。
blocks.en: This process inventory is the backbone of the QMS architecture and is also documented information that auditors always check.

blocks.zh: 比喻：QMS 範圍 = 保險的承保範圍
blocks.en: Analogy: QMS Scope = the Coverage of an Insurance Policy

blocks.zh: 4.3 的 QMS 範圍就像保險單的「承保範圍」：你必須清楚說明涵蓋了哪些地址、哪些產品、哪些活動。範圍外的事項，保險不負責——ISO 認證也不涵蓋。CDMO 若有多個廠址、多條產品線，每個範圍決定都需要書面依據。
blocks.en: The QMS scope in 4.3 is like the "coverage" of an insurance policy: you must state clearly which addresses, products and activities are covered. Anything outside the scope is not insured, and likewise not covered by the ISO certificate. A CDMO with multiple sites and product lines needs a written justification for each scope decision.

blocks.zh: 4.1 — PESTLE 分析框架
blocks.en: 4.1: PESTLE Analysis Framework

blocks.zh: 標準 NOTE 2 提示的外部議題對應 PESTLE 分析：
blocks.en: The external issues suggested in NOTE 2 of the standard map onto the PESTLE analysis:

blocks.zh: 領導力 — 最高管理者的 10 項承諾、品質政策、組織角色
blocks.en: Leadership: Top Management's 10 Commitments, Quality Policy, Organizational Roles

blocks.zh: 領導力：不只是簽名
blocks.en: Leadership: More Than Signing Documents

blocks.zh: 5.1 — 最高管理者的 10 項行動（稽核重點）
blocks.en: 5.1: The 10 Actions of Top Management (Audit Focus)

blocks.zh: 稽核員看的不是「最高管理者有沒有簽批品質政策」，而是有沒有實質行動的證據：
blocks.en: What auditors look for is not whether top management has signed off the quality policy, but evidence of substantive action:

blocks.zh: 管理審查會議記錄（親自主持？還是委派？）
blocks.en: Management review meeting minutes (did top management chair them personally, or delegate?)

blocks.zh: 品質目標與公司策略的連結文件
blocks.en: Documents linking quality objectives to company strategy

blocks.zh: 品質議題在董事會 / 高層會議的討論紀錄
blocks.en: Records of quality topics discussed at board / senior management meetings

blocks.zh: 資源投入決策（人力、設備）的核准記錄
blocks.en: Approval records for resource decisions (staff, equipment)

blocks.zh: 對員工的溝通記錄（全體大會、Email、內部公告）
blocks.en: Records of communication to employees (all-hands meetings, emails, internal announcements)

blocks.zh: 5.1.2 顧客導向 — 製藥的 CQA 連結
blocks.en: 5.1.2 Customer Focus: the Pharmaceutical Link to CQAs

blocks.zh: 對製藥 CDMO：「客戶需求」包括：
blocks.en: For a pharmaceutical CDMO, "customer requirements" include:

blocks.zh: 產品的 CQA（關鍵品質屬性），如純度、含量、無菌性
blocks.en: Product CQAs (critical quality attributes), such as purity, assay and sterility

blocks.zh: 法規要求：FDA / EMA / ICH 要求
blocks.en: Regulatory requirements: FDA / EMA / ICH requirements

blocks.zh: 合約要求：交期、包裝規格、穩定性數據
blocks.en: Contractual requirements: delivery time, packaging specifications, stability data

blocks.zh: 隱性需求：客戶未明說但期待的服務水準
blocks.en: Implicit needs: the level of service the customer expects but has not stated

blocks.zh: 最高管理者必須確保組織有機制持續追蹤並滿足上述需求，而非僅靠業務部門口頭溝通。
blocks.en: Top management must ensure the organization has a mechanism to continuously track and meet these requirements, rather than relying only on verbal communication from the sales department.

blocks.zh: 5.3 — 2015 版重大改變：無管理代表（MR）要求
blocks.en: 5.3: A Major Change in the 2015 Version: No Management Representative (MR) Requirement

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2008 要求指定一名管理代表（Management Representative）。
blocks.en: ISO 9001:2008 required the appointment of a Management Representative.

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2015 刪除了此要求。原因：避免品質被「外包給一個 QA 主管負責」，強調品質是整個組織 / 最高管理者的責任。
blocks.en: ISO 9001:2015 removed this requirement. The reason: to avoid quality being "outsourced to a single QA manager", and to stress that quality is the responsibility of the whole organization and of top management.

blocks.zh: 實務上許多組織仍指定品質主管執行這些功能，但標準不再強制指定單一「管理代表」頭銜。
blocks.en: In practice many organizations still assign these functions to a quality manager, but the standard no longer mandates a single "management representative" title.

blocks.zh: 品質政策的六項要求（5.2 總結）
blocks.en: The Six Requirements for the Quality Policy (Summary of 5.2)

blocks.zh: 適合組織目的與背景
blocks.en: Is appropriate to the purpose and context of the organization

blocks.zh: 與策略方向一致
blocks.en: Is aligned with the strategic direction

blocks.zh: 提供品質目標的框架
blocks.en: Provides a framework for setting quality objectives

blocks.zh: 包含滿足要求的承諾
blocks.en: Includes a commitment to satisfy applicable requirements

blocks.zh: 包含持續改善的承諾
blocks.en: Includes a commitment to continual improvement

blocks.zh: 以文件化資訊形式存在並傳達
blocks.en: Is available as documented information and is communicated

blocks.zh: 稽核常見問題：品質政策貼在牆上，但員工問起不知道內容——這違反「被溝通、理解和應用」的要求。
blocks.en: Common audit finding: the quality policy is posted on the wall, but employees do not know its content when asked. This violates the requirement that it be "communicated, understood and applied."

blocks.zh: 比喻：最高管理者是「品質文化的體溫計」
blocks.en: Analogy: Top Management Is the "Thermometer of Quality Culture"

blocks.zh: 組織的品質文化溫度，由最高管理者的行為決定。如果 CEO 在會議上說「這個出貨不符合規格，但客戶急，先出」——這一句話讓整個品質體系失效。反之，若最高管理者主動參與 CAPA 討論，品質意識自然向下擴散。
blocks.en: The temperature of an organization's quality culture is set by the behavior of top management. If the CEO says in a meeting, "This shipment does not meet specification, but the customer is in a hurry, so ship it", that one sentence defeats the whole quality system. Conversely, when top management actively takes part in CAPA discussions, quality awareness naturally spreads downward.

blocks.zh: 策劃 — 風險與機會、品質目標、變更規劃
blocks.en: Planning: Risks and Opportunities, Quality Objectives, Planning of Changes

blocks.zh: 策劃解析：從 PESTLE 到行動
blocks.en: Planning Explained: From PESTLE to Action

blocks.zh: 6.2 — 品質目標 = SMART 目標
blocks.en: 6.2: Quality Objectives = SMART Objectives

blocks.zh: 標準要求品質目標必須「可量測（measurable）」——這直接對應 SMART 原則：
blocks.en: The standard requires quality objectives to be "measurable", which maps directly onto the SMART principle:

blocks.zh: Specific：明確說明要達成什麼
blocks.en: Specific: state clearly what is to be achieved

blocks.zh: Measurable：有量化指標（如批次良率 ≥ 98%）
blocks.en: Measurable: has a quantitative indicator (e.g., batch yield ≥ 98%)

blocks.zh: Achievable：可實現，有資源支持
blocks.en: Achievable: realistic, with resources to support it

blocks.zh: Relevant：與品質政策和客戶需求相關
blocks.en: Relevant: related to the quality policy and customer needs

blocks.zh: Time-bound：有明確完成時限
blocks.en: Time-bound: has a clear deadline

blocks.zh: 製藥 CDMO 常見品質目標：OOS 率、客訴次數、CAPA 準時關閉率、稽核不符合項數。
blocks.en: Common quality objectives for a pharmaceutical CDMO: OOS rate, number of customer complaints, on-time CAPA closure rate, number of audit nonconformities.

blocks.zh: 6.3 — 變更管理 (Change Control)
blocks.en: 6.3: Change Control

blocks.zh: 6.3 要求 QMS 的變更要「有計畫地進行」。這直接對應製藥業的變更管制（Change Control）系統：
blocks.en: 6.3 requires changes to the QMS to be carried out "in a planned manner". This maps directly onto the pharmaceutical change control system:

blocks.zh: 任何對 SOP、設備、製程、廠址的變更
blocks.en: Any change to SOPs, equipment, processes or sites

blocks.zh: 需評估對產品品質、客戶要求、法規合規的影響
blocks.en: The impact on product quality, customer requirements and regulatory compliance must be assessed

blocks.zh: 必須有核准流程和影響評估記錄
blocks.en: There must be an approval process and impact assessment records

blocks.zh: 對重大變更：可能需要通知主管機關或客戶
blocks.en: For major changes: notification to the regulatory authority or the customer may be required

blocks.zh: 比喻：風險管理 = 製藥業已在做的事
blocks.en: Analogy: Risk Management = What the Pharmaceutical Industry Already Does

blocks.zh: 對製藥人來說，6.1「風險與機會」並不陌生——這就是 ICH Q9 在做的事。ISO 9001 的風險管理比 ICH Q9 更寬，延伸到商業風險（供應商中斷、市場需求改變），但核心邏輯完全一致：識別 → 評估 → 應對 → 監控。
blocks.en: For pharmaceutical professionals, "risks and opportunities" in 6.1 are nothing new: this is what ICH Q9 does. ISO 9001 risk management is broader than ICH Q9 and extends to business risks (supplier disruption, changes in market demand), but the core logic is identical: identify → assess → address → monitor.

blocks.zh: 6.1 — 風險管理工具（非強制，但推薦）
blocks.en: 6.1: Risk Management Tools (Not Mandatory, but Recommended)

blocks.zh: 標準不要求特定工具，但常用方法：
blocks.en: The standard does not require specific tools, but commonly used methods include:

blocks.zh: 風險應對行動必須與潛在影響成比例——高風險投入更多資源，低風險可接受或監控即可。
blocks.en: Actions to address risks must be proportionate to the potential impact: invest more resources in high risks, while low risks can be accepted or simply monitored.

blocks.zh: 支援 — 資源、人員能力、意識、溝通、文件化資訊
blocks.en: Support: Resources, Competence, Awareness, Communication, Documented Information

blocks.zh: 支援體系解析
blocks.en: The Support System Explained

blocks.zh: 7.1.5 — 量測溯源 (Metrological Traceability)
blocks.en: 7.1.5: Metrological Traceability

blocks.zh: 製藥廠的量測管理是 GMP 核心之一：
blocks.en: Measurement management is one of the cores of GMP in a pharmaceutical plant:

blocks.zh: 每台量測設備必須定期校正（校正週期 + 標準品溯源至 NIST/BIPM）
blocks.en: Every measuring device must be calibrated periodically (calibration interval + reference standards traceable to NIST/BIPM)

blocks.zh: 校正記錄必須保存（文件化資訊）
blocks.en: Calibration records must be retained (documented information)

blocks.zh: 發現設備失效 → 必須評估過去量測結果的有效性
blocks.en: When a device is found to be out of order → the validity of past measurement results must be assessed

blocks.zh: 設備管理清單 + 校正標籤 = 基本合規要求
blocks.en: Equipment inventory + calibration labels = baseline compliance requirement

blocks.zh: 7.1.6 — 組織知識：製藥業最被低估的條款
blocks.en: 7.1.6: Organizational Knowledge, the Most Underrated Clause in Pharmaceuticals

blocks.zh: 這是 ISO 9001:2015 新增的條款，也是製藥業最容易忽視的要求。
blocks.en: This is a new clause in ISO 9001:2015 and one of the requirements most easily overlooked in the pharmaceutical industry.

blocks.zh: 常見的知識流失場景：
blocks.en: Common knowledge-loss scenarios:

blocks.zh: 資深 QP（授權人）離職 → 帶走多年法規判斷經驗
blocks.en: A senior QP (Qualified Person) leaves → years of regulatory judgment experience walk out the door

blocks.zh: 製程研發人員跳槽 → 配方優化的隱性知識無處找
blocks.en: Process development staff move on → the tacit knowledge behind formulation optimization cannot be found

blocks.zh: 舊設備報廢 → 操作技巧和異常排除方法沒有文件記錄
blocks.en: Old equipment is scrapped → operating tips and troubleshooting methods were never documented

blocks.zh: 客戶技術轉移完成後 → 原研究的脈絡和決策依據遺失
blocks.en: After a customer's technology transfer is completed → the context and decision rationale of the original research are lost

blocks.zh: 應對策略：知識管理計畫、技術文件化、師徒制、離職移交規程、經驗教訓資料庫（Lessons Learned）
blocks.en: Countermeasures: knowledge management plan, technical documentation, mentoring, handover procedures for departing staff, lessons-learned database

blocks.zh: 7.2 — 四步驟能力管理流程
blocks.en: 7.2: The Four-Step Competence Management Process

blocks.zh: 確定：哪些崗位需要什麼能力？（工作說明書、能力矩陣）
blocks.en: Determine: what competence is needed for which positions? (job descriptions, competence matrix)

blocks.zh: 確保：透過訓練、招募、外包獲得所需能力
blocks.en: Ensure: obtain the needed competence through training, recruitment or outsourcing

blocks.zh: 保持：持續教育、年度複訓、能力評估
blocks.en: Maintain: continuing education, annual refresher training, competence assessment

blocks.zh: 保留證據：訓練記錄、測驗成績、OJT 表單（文件化資訊）
blocks.en: Retain evidence: training records, test scores, OJT forms (documented information)

blocks.zh: 注意：學歷/資格 ≠ 能力。能力需要通過評估證明，而非只看證書。
blocks.en: Note: education/qualifications ≠ competence. Competence must be demonstrated through assessment, not judged by certificates alone.

blocks.zh: 7.5 — 「文件化資訊」統一術語的意義
blocks.en: 7.5: The Significance of the Unified Term "Documented Information"

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2008 使用三個不同術語：
blocks.en: ISO 9001:2008 used three different terms:

blocks.zh: 文件（Documents）— SOP、標準、程序
blocks.en: Documents: SOPs, standards, procedures

blocks.zh: 品質手冊（Quality Manual）— 強制要求
blocks.en: Quality Manual: mandatory

blocks.zh: 記錄（Records）— 活動的證據
blocks.en: Records: evidence of activities

blocks.zh: ISO 9001:2015 統一為 「文件化資訊（Documented Information）」：
blocks.en: ISO 9001:2015 unified these into "Documented Information":

blocks.zh: 「維持文件化資訊」= 過去的「文件」（隨時更新的文件）
blocks.en: "Maintain documented information" = the former "documents" (kept up to date at all times)

blocks.zh: 「保留文件化資訊」= 過去的「記錄」（不可更改的證據）
blocks.en: "Retain documented information" = the former "records" (unalterable evidence)

blocks.zh: 製藥 QMS 文件體系需要據此更新術語，但實質要求並未重大改變。品質手冊不再強制要求，但仍推薦作為 QMS 架構說明。
blocks.en: A pharmaceutical QMS documentation system needs its terminology updated accordingly, but the substantive requirements have not changed significantly. The quality manual is no longer mandatory, but is still recommended as a description of the QMS architecture.

blocks.zh: 製藥 CDMO 實作思考
blocks.en: Practical Considerations for a Pharmaceutical CDMO

blocks.zh: 你的工廠如何回答以下 Clause 7 稽核問題？
blocks.en: How would your site answer the following Clause 7 audit questions?

blocks.zh: Cl.7.1.6：當資深員工離職，你如何確保關鍵技術知識不流失？有 Lessons Learned 資料庫嗎？
blocks.en: Cl.7.1.6: When a senior employee leaves, how do you ensure critical technical knowledge is not lost? Do you have a lessons-learned database?

blocks.zh: Cl.7.2：訓練記錄只有出席簽到表，還是有能力評估紀錄？
blocks.en: Cl.7.2: Do training records consist only of attendance sign-in sheets, or are there competence assessment records?

blocks.zh: Cl.7.3：操作人員知道他們的工作如何影響客戶和患者嗎？
blocks.en: Cl.7.3: Do operators know how their work affects customers and patients?

blocks.zh: Cl.7.5.3：電子文件系統有版本控制嗎？紙本記錄防止未授權修改嗎？
blocks.en: Cl.7.5.3: Does the electronic document system have version control? Do paper records prevent unauthorized changes?

blocks.zh: 比喻：組織知識 = 企業的「隱性資產」
blocks.en: Analogy: Organizational Knowledge = the Company's "Hidden Assets"

blocks.zh: 財務報表列不出「20 年製程優化知識」的價值，但這往往是 CDMO 最核心的競爭優勢。7.1.6 要求組織對這類隱性資產進行管理——就像你會定期備份電腦資料一樣，知識也需要「備份」到文件和系統中，而不是只留在幾個人的腦袋裡。
blocks.en: The value of "20 years of process optimization knowledge" does not appear on the financial statements, yet it is often a CDMO's most important competitive advantage. 7.1.6 requires the organization to manage such hidden assets. Just as you back up your computer data regularly, knowledge also needs to be "backed up" into documents and systems, rather than left in the heads of a few people.

blocks.zh: 7.5.2 — ALCOA 精神的 ISO 對應
blocks.en: 7.5.2: The ISO Counterpart of the ALCOA Spirit

blocks.zh: 7.5.2 的文件建立要求對應製藥業的 ALCOA+ 原則：
blocks.en: The document creation requirements of 7.5.2 correspond to the pharmaceutical ALCOA+ principles:

blocks.zh: 第1-7節重點摘要
blocks.en: Summary of Key Points for Clauses 1-7
